name: Inkora Builder
author: talha7766

sections.description:
Inkora Builder adds 15+ specialized Gutenberg blocks to help you build professional news and magazine websites without coding.

Key Features

  • Hero Slider Block – Featured posts slider with multiple layout options
  • Breaking News Ticker – Horizontal scrolling news ticker
  • Category Tabs – Tabbed layout for different categories
  • Featured Grid – Magazine-style grid layouts (2, 3, 4 columns)
  • Video Gallery Block – YouTube/Vimeo video showcase
  • Poll/Voting Block – Create interactive polls with AJAX voting
  • Latest Posts Grid – Customizable post grid with multiple styles
  • News Ticker (Vertical) – Vertical scrolling headlines
  • Author Box Block – Responsive author information display
  • Social Share Block – Share buttons for major platforms
  • Related Posts Block – Automatic related posts by category/tags
  • Newsletter Block – Email subscription integration
  • Table of Contents Block – Auto-generated post TOC
  • Review Block – Star rating system with schema markup
  • Advertisement Block – Ad manager with responsive slots

Block Controls

Each block offers:
– Responsive visibility (hide on desktop/tablet/mobile)
– Custom CSS class support

Performance Optimized

  • Lightweight CSS (< 50KB minified)
  • No external dependencies (except Gutenberg)
  • Lazy loading for images
  • Dynamic rendering for polls and tickers

Developer Friendly

  • WordPress coding standards compliant
  • Hooks and filters for customization
  • Extendable block architecture
  • Full REST API support for dynamic blocks

Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.8 and higher
  • PHP 7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3
  • All Gutenberg-ready themes
  • RTL languages supported
  • Translation ready (.pot file included)

External Services

This plugin uses the Vimeo API to fetch video metadata.

  • Service: Vimeo API
  • Purpose: To fetch video metadata (title, thumbnail, duration) when user provides a Vimeo URL
  • Data sent: Vimeo video ID only
  • When: When a user enters a Vimeo URL in the video block
  • Terms: https://vimeo.com/terms
  • Privacy: https://vimeo.com/privacy

Unsplash Images (Static Demo Content):
– Service: Unsplash (https://unsplash.com)
– Purpose: Only used as static placeholder images in demo blocks
– Data sent: No data – images are included locally in the plugin
– License: Unsplash License (free for commercial use)

Additional Info

This plugin requires WordPress 5.8 or higher. Gutenberg plugin is NOT required as blocks are built with native WordPress components.

Translations Included

  • English (default)
  • .pot file included for custom translations

Credits

Icons courtesy of WordPress Dashicons (GPL compatible).

Support

For support: inkora@softwarelinkers.biz
Documentation: https://softwarelinkers.biz/inkora-builder/docs

Donate link: https://softwarelinkers.biz/donate
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Inkora Builder”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download inkora-builder.zip
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and click Activate

After Activation

Once activated, you’ll find:
– All Inkora blocks in the Gutenberg block inserter
– Inkora Settings page under WordPress Settings menu
– New blocks ready to use in any post/page
sections.faq:
Does this work with any theme?

Yes! Inkora Builder works with any WordPress theme that supports Gutenberg (which is all modern themes).

Does it slow down my website?

No. We’ve optimized all blocks to load only on pages where they’re used. The core CSS is under 50KB.

Can I use it with Elementor/Other builders?

Yes, the blocks work independently. However, for best experience, we recommend using Gutenberg.

How to report bugs?

Please report issues on our support forum or contact us through our website.
